items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Steve Massico and Al Moore, that same band that I was telling you about.

ctx.x: And you had a band or singers too?

Steve Massico and Al Moore, that same band that I was telling you about. All of us worked in the war plant in Higgins, and they would let us all out, and we wouldn't lose any time at Higgins. And we got paid just enough compensation to pay for our food that we ate on the road. We didn't get any money for it tomorrow.
We didn't have a girl singer? No.
